title: Repo path is a symlink: orchestrator repo = deployed copy
summary: Finding (2026-06-10): /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/orchestrator is a symlink to ~/.claude/orchestrator — the repo and the "deployed copy" are the same directory. There is no separate deployment: edits land live on disk immediately and only a daemon restart is needed to activate them. Any "sync repo → deployed" step is a no-op; drop such steps from worker prompts and runbooks.
